comment_data.body:
To me, it feels a little morally dubious to treat "module_pxd" differently from "module".

My proposed fix, which I think makes it a bit more symmetric, is at 86410b4cf2abcd76bbc06ac782d0c6c333840c49

commit.message: Stop checking for "module" since that seems to break things, remove duplicate scope setting, move comment disable to correct location.
Try broader change from David Woods

milestone.description:
Main features:
- Pattern matching
- Generics / subscripted container types
- `@cython.collection_type()`
- `restrict`
- more vectorcalls
- more thread safety
- smaller modules, more shared code
- remove Py3.8 support, keep Py3.9+
